description: Evaluating the performance of historic masonry in Mayfield after the 2021 tornado is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rebecca Napolitano, Penn State University (psu.edu). This data was curated for the damaged buidlings in Mayfield. The data was completed using the streetview images, unmanned aerial vehicle images and inspector note to fill the missing blanks. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-zwg3-nv98. Keywords: Tornado damage, historic buildings. Published 2022-12-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
